name: A Humble Offering
label: Quest
description: A Humble Offering: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Ishnu-alah, traveler. Show me proof of the demise of a Lord of the Abyssal Council and I shall reward you with an item that should aid you in your battles against the Qiraji.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Fandu-dath-belore? Oh, pardon me, friend. I did not recognize you. Have you the scepter?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Ande'thoras-ethil. It means; 'May your troubles be diminished,' in my native tongue.
Wear the band proudly and in good health, friend.
